readingReviewNotes: Eight original practice passages and two heldout assessments; two paragraphs, six authored sentence blocks and two evidence-linked questions per passage.
Ordinary passages provide actual surface witnesses for every new function; prerequisite declarations are checked separately.
Cannot infer universal permission from age, facts from missing records, consent from silence, or agreement from a stated intention.
Corrected temporary stopping, interpreting speech, scheduling later, setting a plan and touching a machine to their actually taught senses.
Existing advanced forms used in passages are declared as prerequisites; productivity and alternative grammatical forms do not inflate root counts.
researchLimitations: Grammar references support selected linguistic facts, not a learning-effectiveness claim.
The 2020 tokorode source was read as its author abstract; the 2017 comparison as its university-listed overview. Full papers are not claimed as read.
Two attempted primary PDF downloads for separate 2018 and 2020 papers failed; neither unavailable full text is cited as inspected evidence.
No upstream examples, full articles, dictionary definitions or audio bundled. No independent Japanese review, native iOS compilation or new IPA.
